name: Do I need to test for asbestos before removing a popcorn ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to test for asbestos before removing a popcorn ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your home was built before 1980, it is highly recommended to have your popcorn ceiling tested for asbestos before beginning any removal work. Asbestos was a common component in older building materials, and disturbing it can release hazardous fibers into the air. A professional asbestos testing service can determine its presence and advise on safe handling or removal procedures, which are crucial for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: If your home was built before 1980, test your popcorn ceiling for asbestos before removal to ensure safety.
